1	verify	'nvvm.redux.sync' op abs attribute is supported only for f32 type
2	verify	'nvvm.redux.sync' op nan attribute is supported only for f32 type
3	verify	'nvvm.redux.sync' op 'add' redux kind unsupported with 'f32' type. Only supported type is 'i32'.
4	verify	'nvvm.redux.sync' op 'and' redux kind unsupported with 'f32' type. Only supported type is 'i32'.
5	verify	'nvvm.redux.sync' op 'fmin' redux kind unsupported with 'i32' type. Only supported type is 'f32'.
6	verify	'nvvm.redux.sync' op failed to verify that all of {res, val} have same type
